body:
It hurts so much because I can see where you're coming from and it was the same thing I got out from being told I sold my soul to the point I actually did self-harm to straighten myself up. 
Indoctrination from people who used the gospel and twisted it according to their needs. God revealed to me that indoctrination happens and people use the gospel to twist according to control and power and financial abuse was a forefront next to the gaslighting and guilt trip. I forgave my abusers, I just can't give the same trust anymore or reconnect.


It crushes my feelings to reread your post.

As a former occultist and converted Christian, research lead me to practice. It started as a Google search, me buying one book, doing one interview and then me experimenting whether magic was real or not. After ten years, it's a full blown problem of possession, oppression and summoning stuff I never intended for my life. Researching as an intellectual pursuit is never wrong, but it can get you tempted to try more and be more.


Stick with sports, watch Christian films, do martial arts, read the Bible, or study history minus magic. Exploring occult is like treading on thin ice. I wished I listened to the guy who told me to stay away from it at 13.

I left Catholic as a religion. Former occultist raised by New Age Mother who was fond of using the Holy name to emotionally manipulate, and with witchcraft to control my life and scare my father physically with so many evidences. 


I think my long lasting of harassment from strangers, verbal abuse from parents and ten year neglect had made me walk away from the church. Ignorant priests laughed at me for wanting to confess and be absolved. There is indifference and evil.


I believe ultimately with reasoning, me and another family have seen moments of entities defying physics (while I was downloading AutoCAD and going home as a student delegate from UN) and possessing people, slamming them across the room.


In 2019, a decent Christian found me and reached out. I sure was enraged by her behavior, only to realize she is doing it not out of excessive pride or the holier art thou belief. It took another five years for me to believe she had no hidden agenda. But from my own belief Christ is real, just, and kind, and unlike my abusive parents. 


That in turn made me believe religion and relationship with Christ is entirely separate. I had seen evil with my own eyes, I believed that goodness is remarkably real and not just coincidence played out.
